title: OpenStack redis
description: Configuration for the Redis data store that backs zaqar's message store (OpenStack-Helm redis, release 2025.1). Only the fields here are settable on a Composition; everything else uses the chart defaults in values.yaml. Deploy all the OpenStack component blueprints into one namespace to form a complete install.
